name: Amp Flow Electric Inc.
old_description: At Amp Flow Electric, we offer a wide range of electrical services for both residential and commercial customers. When choosing Amp Flow, you get 20 years of experience in the electrical field  and 10 years of experience in solar (NABCEP Certified).Whether you need a minor repair or a major installation, we've got you covered.
about:
Amp Flow Electric Inc. was founded in 2006 in Bristol, Rhode Island. The company provides electrical and solar services to residential and commercial clients across the region. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm specializes in electrical repairs, including faulty wiring and appliance fixes, as well as electrical installations such as new wiring, circuit breaker panel upgrades, and outlet additions. Its solar division, backed by ten years of experience and NABCEP certification, handles solar installations, maintenance, and system upgrades. The company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual project volumes.

Amp Flow Electric serves both residential homeowners and commercial businesses. Its customer base includes property owners seeking repairs, upgrades, or renewable energy solutions. No specific industry verticals or named clients are mentioned in available materials.

The company emphasizes customized solutions tailored to each client's unique needs, citing attention to detail and a commitment to excellence. Its stated differentiators include two decades of electrical field experience and a decade of NABCEP-certified solar expertise.
